c = SCAN_TABLE(contracts) -> COMPUTE(aid = canon_award_id(award_id), uei = canon_uei(recipient_uei))
top = c -> AGGREGATE(uei; COUNT(DISTINCT aid) AS n_contracts) -> SORT(n_contracts DESC) -> LIMIT(10)
tc = JOIN(left=c, right=top, on c.uei = top.uei)
old = SCAN_TABLE(contract_amounts) -> FILTER(award_id LIKE '%_OLD') -> COMPUTE(aid = canon_award_id(regexp_replace(award_id, '_OLD$', '')))
JOIN(left=tc, right=old, on tc.aid = old.aid) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(DISTINCT aid) AS n)
basis: award_id/UEI/NAICS 的噪声（OCR 替换、前缀、大小写、分隔符）用确定性 COMPUTE 规范化后等值连接，amount_text 以确定性解析器转数值（含英文数词与加和式）；按 contracts 中规范 UEI 的合同数取前10收款方，统计其合同在 contract_amounts 中带 _OLD 后缀（被取代金额）的数量；“收款方”按 UEI 还是按 recipients 规范名/n_contracts 计有歧义。
